title: A new home in the hutong

steps.now: Go out into the courtyard and say hello to 王阿姨, your landlady.
Have breakfast at the 早点铺 on 南锣鼓巷: out of the courtyard gate, then east along the lane.
Go back to the courtyard and look at 王阿姨's old lantern.
The lantern's spirits have run off. Ask people if they have seen anything strange — the teahouse 茶馆 and the corner shop 小卖部 on 南锣鼓巷 hear everything.
They say the stone lion by the Drum Tower 鼓楼 moves at night. Ask the way if you need to (it is west of your lane), and go after dark — 老刘 at the teahouse lets you sit till evening.
The spirits could be anywhere in Beijing. Buy a 交通卡 at 南锣鼓巷 station, at the east end of the lanes.
Take the subway to 天安门东: through the gates (tap your card), find the board on the platform, line 8 south to 王府井, then line 1 one stop.
赵爷爷’s bird flew off. The kid 小明 plays in the lanes — ask him.
Take the bird back to 赵爷爷 on 南锣鼓巷.
Get a haircut at 张师傅’s on 南锣鼓巷 (30 元).
小明’s kite is stuck in the 槐树 of 帽儿胡同. Buy a bamboo pole 竹竿 at the corner shop and use it on the kite (🎒 → Use).
Give the kite back to 小明 (🎒 → Use on him).
Your keys are gone. Ask the neighbours if they have seen them.
小明 saw them in the dark corner of 帽儿胡同. A torch 手电筒 from the corner shop — use it on the corner.
王阿姨 wants a photo of a red gate. Use your 手机 on the door gods’ gate in 大栅栏.
Show 王阿姨 the photo (use your 手机 on her).
王阿姨 misses her son abroad. Listen to her — maybe she could call him?
Come back to the courtyard in the morning (7–11) and help 王阿姨 call her son.
张师傅 is telling you about his first shop.
His first customer was 赵爷爷. Ask 赵爷爷 on 南锣鼓巷 about the old shop.
Take 赵爷爷’s old photo to 张师傅 at the barber’s.
赵爷爷 is telling you about his bird.
Meet 赵爷爷 on the 鼓楼 square in the early morning (6–9).
赵爷爷 has no umbrella. 李阿姨 sells them on rainy days — use one on him from your bag.
赵爷爷 will give your umbrella back on a dry day. Look for him on 南锣鼓巷.
Put 春联 and a 福 on your gate: buy them at 李阿姨’s in winter, then use them on a lantern beside your red gate in 帽儿胡同.
Give 小明 a 红包 (李阿姨 sells them) and wish him a happy new year — during 春节 or 元宵.
Buy something nice for your room — flowers or a paper-cut at 李阿姨’s, a lantern at 潘家园, calligraphy at the 王府井 bookshop, an opera mask at the 前门 theatre — and use it on a spot in your room (墙, 窗户, 地上).
Talk to 王阿姨 — she wants to see your room.
Feed the little cat in 帽儿胡同 on three different days: buy 小鱼干 at 李阿姨’s and use it on the cat.
The cat trusts you. Look at it and give it a name: 它叫……
Take a photo of the Drum Tower 鼓楼 for 小明: tap 📷 on the 鼓楼 square and put the tower in the frame.
Show 小明 the photo — he is in 帽儿胡同.
Take a photo of the Great Wall’s watchtower for 老刘: tap 📷 on the Wall.
Show 老刘 the photo at the teahouse.
Play Chinese chess with the old man on 南锣鼓巷 — say which piece you move.
In the evening, dance with the aunties on the 鼓楼 square — do what she calls.
At New Year, make dumplings with 王阿姨 — do each step she says.
老刘 at the teahouse has a joke for you. Listen, and laugh if you get it.
The delivery rider in 帽儿胡同 (in the evening) cannot find a house number — help him.
In the morning a recycler rides through 帽儿胡同 calling out — talk to him.

title: 《骆驼祥子》 — a cart of his own

steps.now: 祥子 on 南锣鼓巷 wants a tricycle of his own. Take his passengers where they ask.
In 老刘’s teahouse a guest keeps bringing up the news. Mind the notice on the wall — talk about the weather or food.
The storyteller in 老刘’s teahouse tells one episode a day. Come back on another day for the next.
Hear the second episode at the teahouse.
